items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: The first band I played with was Foster Lewis and Dude. Because Roussel, or Bud Roussel was playing bass with them. That was the first band I would play with.

ctx.x: Seems to me he came out about the time... I think it was Cuckoo, and then Moran at the El Moraco, and then Percy. No, long before that.

No, long before that huh? Because you remember when I was telling you about the... We played over in Biloxi. I think Butt Roussel had him on trumpet, I'm more than sure. Mm-hmm. He was on trumpet and his brother, Brother Earl, was on trombone. That was the first time I ever played with him. But he didn't play in the El Moraco, Percy? He might have played a couple of times in Cuckoo's place, I don't know. Mm-hmm. It's hard for me to memorize it right now. Was Moran in the El Moraco? I think he played with us one…
What about Kid Sheik? Did you ever play with him?
